requirements: R1: The system must allow an Epidemiologist to digitally sign or approve a generated dossier report.

slices.title: Implement dossier signature functionality
slices.jtbd: When implementing the dossier signature for this epic, I want to patch the existing EmployeeDossierController, so that the right to sign the dossier is fulfilled.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given I am logged in as an Epidemiologist, When I submit a signature for a generated dossier report, Then the system records the signature/approval successfully.
Given I am reviewing the code, When the automated test suite runs, Then the new signature functionality is covered by positive and negative tests.

epics.title: Dossier Reports List Pagination
epics.jtbd: When retrieving dossier reports, I want to fetch a paginated list of all generated reports, so that I can browse reports efficiently without knowing their exact IDs.
requirements: R1: The API must provide a paginated list endpoint for generated dossier reports.

slices.title: Implement dossier reports list pagination endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the pagination endpoint for this epic, I want to add a paginated list endpoint to the existing reports controller, so that clients can browse reports efficiently.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given there are multiple dossier reports, When I call the reports list endpoint with pagination parameters, Then I receive a paginated list of reports rather than just individual lookups.
Given I am reviewing the code, When the test suite runs, Then the pagination endpoint is verified by integration tests.
